items.title: Spiral Rosebud Vine DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Wall Art
items.description: A single vine climbs the panel's edge, sprouting spiral rosebuds, curling tendrils, and pointed leaves along its length. Compared to other vine designs in this collection, the spiral rosebud motif here is more compact and evenly spaced, giving the piece a tidier, more structured rhythm.

items.title: Triple Circle Medallion Scroll DXF Panel for CNC Gates
items.description: Three matching circular medallions stack vertically down the panel, each filled with an intricate ringed knot pattern and connected by bands of flowing scrollwork. The repeating medallion rhythm gives this design a strong sense of order missing from the more asymmetrical pieces in the collection.
